```{r}

library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(geiger)
library(nlme)
library(caper)

trees_file <- '/Users/meganyoumans/Desktop/Adelphi Coursework/Statistical Modeling/Assignments/HW 8/tree-pruner-67ce5eb0-b7df-4525-8a8f-56929bff3cfc/output.nex'
trees <- read.nexus(trees_file)
consensus_tree <- ls.consensus(trees, rooted = T)
plot(consensus_tree)

trait_data <- read.csv('/Users/meganyoumans/Desktop/Adelphi Coursework/Statistical Modeling/Assignments/HW 8/ELEData/TraitData/AVONET3_BirdTree_CSV.csv')
trait_data$Species3 <- gsub(" ","_",trait_data$Species3)
rownames(trait_data) <- trait_data$Species3
name.check(consensus_tree, trait_data)

##Make a version of the species data that only has the tip labels on the consensus tree data 

traitsclean <- trait_data[trait_data$Species3 %in% consensus_tree$tip.label, ]

##we only want the 50 birds from the data set, not the 10,000 birds showing, so get rid of the rest - not drop tip 
##take speceies we want and all data set species and then filter - filter on rows [row,column] 
##we want species that we want only, that are in species on trait 

name.check(consensus_tree, traitsclean)


print(traitsclean)

##PGLS sorting 
## phylogenetic generalized least squares (PGLS) 

##have to transfer data wing and tail length to numeric 
traitsclean$Wing.Length <- as.numeric(traitsclean$Wing.Length)
traitsclean$Tail.Length <- as.numeric(traitsclean$Tail.Length)
##have to load a library nlme for gls to work first) 

bm <- corBrownian(1, phy = consensus_tree, form = ~Species3)

modelo1 <- gls(Wing.Length ~ Tail.Length, data = traitsclean, correlation = bm)
summary(modelo1)

##AIC of 520.4662
##tvalue of tail length 3.63, intercept 6.41, pvalue highly negative 

modelo2 <- gls(Wing.Length ~ Tail.Length, data = traitsclean, correlation = corPagel(1, phy = consensus_tree, form = ~Species3))
summary(modelo2)
##AIC of 514.813
##tvalue of tail length 3.46, intercept 6.36, pvalue 0.0011


modelo3 <- gls(Wing.Length ~ Tail.Length + Mass, data = traitsclean, correlation = corPagel(1, phy = consensus_tree, form = ~Species3))
summary(modelo3)

##AIC of 526.1036
##tvalue of tail length 1.08, pvalue 0.2825
##tvalue of mass 1.67, pvalue 0.1010

##bird wings are slightly correlated in size to bird mass size 

##Install caper package and load 

traits_small <- traitsclean[, c("Species3", "Wing.Length", "Tail.Length", "Mass")]
summary(traits_small)
comp.data<-comparative.data(consensus_tree, traits_small, names.col="Species3", vcv.dim=2, warn.dropped=TRUE)
summary(comp.data)

modelo4<-pgls(Wing.Length ~ Tail.Length, data = comp.data, lambda = "ML")
summary(modelo4)

##p-value: 0.0006852

modelo5<-pgls(Wing.Length ~ Tail.Length + Mass, data=comp.data, lambda="ML")
summary(modelo5)

##p-value = 0.000914

modelo6<-pgls(traitsclean$Tarsus.Length~ Wing.Length, data=comp.data, lambda="ML")
summary(modelo6)

##p-value = 0.618 

lm.lk<-pgls.profile(modelo6, which="lambda")
plot(lm.lk)


##Species share traits through common ancestry... Looking for shared trait values on the tree. Length of tarsus tail relates to wing length in birds. 



```


Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
